# Ciel

> Ciel is a design studio making sculptural pieces for the home, operated by Napieralski Holdings LLC. Its first piece is the Onde Clock: a gloss black lacquered wall clock with three domed dials, designed, prototyped and made in house, one at a time.

Products, prices and descriptions on this site load live from the Ciel Shopify store. The Onde Clock is currently taking sign-ups ahead of its first batch.

## Products

- [Onde Clock](https://cieldesign.shop/products/onde-clock): Gloss black sculptural wall clock. Three domed dials keep the hours, minutes and seconds, each marked by a single point of light. Hand finished lacquer, LED accent lighting, silent movement. Approx. 15 x 15 x 3 in (38 x 38 x 8 cm). $2,445 USD. Built to order; ships after the first batch is made.
- [All products](https://cieldesign.shop/products): The current Ciel collection.

## About

- [About Ciel](https://cieldesign.shop/about): A studio and a curated collection. In house designs, shown alongside pieces from makers and design houses we admire.
- [Contact](https://cieldesign.shop/contact): Questions about a piece, a preorder or an order. Replies within two business days.

## Policies

- [Terms of Sale](https://cieldesign.shop/terms): Shipping times, returns (14 days, 20% restocking fee), warranty (up to one year on Ciel designs) and pricing in USD.
- [Privacy Policy](https://cieldesign.shop/privacy): What information Ciel collects and how it is used. Ciel does not sell personal information.
